description: This source file implements the loader component for a build system, managing the loading and initialization of build configuration files, toolchains, and source files within the GN build system. It handles asynchronous file loading, toolchain management, and build configuration setup.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: Base class for the build system loader.

classes.name: LoaderImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing build file loading, toolchains, and build configurations.

classes.name: LoaderImpl::LoadID
classes.description: Struct to uniquely identify a loaded file in a specific toolchain.

classes.name: LoaderImpl::ToolchainRecord
classes.description: Tracks the state and settings of a specific toolchain.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Initiates loading of a build file or source file.

methods.name: ToolchainLoaded
methods.description: Marks a toolchain as loaded and triggers dependent file loads.

methods.name: GetDefaultToolchain
methods.description: Returns the label of the default toolchain.

methods.name: GetToolchainSettings
methods.description: Retrieves settings for a specified toolchain.

methods.name: BuildFileForLabel
methods.description: Constructs the build file path for a given label.

methods.name: ScheduleLoadFile
methods.description: Schedules asynchronous loading of a build or source file.

methods.name: ScheduleLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Schedules loading of a build configuration file.

methods.name: BackgroundLoadFile
methods.description: Processes the loaded source file, executing its parse tree.

methods.name: BackgroundLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Processes the loaded build configuration, setting up build scope.

methods.name: DidLoadFile
methods.description: Callback after a file has been loaded.

methods.name: DidLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Callback after a build config has been loaded, updates toolchain info.

methods.name: DecrementPendingLoads
methods.description: Decreases the count of pending loads and triggers completion callback if zero.

methods.name: AsyncLoadFile
methods.description: Performs asynchronous file load, either via custom callback or default input file manager.
